question: Evaluate the net income gap between low income group d1 to d4, middle income group d5 to d9 and high income group d10 in Vietnam and propose improvement plan
query: To get the required data, you can use the following SQL query. Here are some steps to follow: 1. Analyze the historical data of relevant indicators such as Gini coefficient, GDP per capita, and net income for low-income groups and high-income group d10 in Vietnam. This will help understand how the income distribution has changed over time. 2. Identify any key drivers behind these trends, such as economic policies, socio-political factors, or external events that may have impacted the income distribution. 3. Consider targeted interventions to address income inequality issues based on the identified drivers. This could include policies aimed at improving access to education and job opportunities for low-income groups, promoting economic growth and employment in rural areas where poverty is more prevalent, or implementing progressive taxation and social protection systems. 4. Monitor the effectiveness of implemented interventions by regularly analyzing the relevant indicators (Gini coefficient, GDP per capita, net income, etc.) to assess whether income distribution has improved over time. 5. Iteratively refine policies based on the results of monitoring and evaluation efforts, with a focus on reducing the gap between low-income groups and high-income group d10 in Vietnam.
